title: Kansa language
description: Siouan language of the Dhegihan group once spoken by the Kaw people
extract: Kansa, sometimes known as Kaw or Kanza, is a Siouan language of the Dhegihan group once spoken by the Kaw people of Oklahoma. Vice President Charles Curtis spoke Kansa as a child. The last mother-tongue speaker, Walter Kekahbah, died in 1983.
